udiff_fo_20260925_full.notes: WHOLE F&O file, untrimmed. THE UNIT MEASUREMENT: SctySrs is blank on all 37,165 rows. TtlTradgVol is positive on 18,072 of them, and TtlTrfVal/TtlTradgVol falls inside [LwPric,HghPric] on 0 of 18,072 - every one is ABOVE the range, none below. Reason: TtlTradgVol counts LOTS while TtlTrfVal is in units of the UNDERLYING, so the ratio is the underlying share price, not the premium. Measured row: ABCAPITAL26OCT450CE, lot size 3100, LwPric 0.45, HghPric 0.80, TtlTradgVol 85, TtlTrfVal 118724575.00 -> 1396759.71. Consequence: the CM VWAP identity does not hold for F&O, so the turnover unit is segment-dependent and is reported per file rather than asserted.

legacy_cm_20230515_full.notes: WHOLE pre-cutover file, untrimmed. THE LEGACY TURNOVER ANSWER: the 14-column schema carries TOTTRDVAL, so traded value is NOT unavailable before the UDiFF cutover. TOTTRDVAL/TOTTRDQTY inside [LOW,HIGH] on 2427/2427 within 1e-9. 70 distinct SERIES. 121 rows are dropped by the (Date,Symbol) dedup (2427 -> 2306 distinct pairs), and 153 rows sit in a colliding group: tickers like BRITANNIA and CHOLAFIN appear under both EQ and a debt series, so a legacy series=None read loses real equity rows. This schema has no FinInstrmNm column, which is why the equity/debt classification reads names and is measured on the UDiFF captures.
